local_edits.why: Note 1: read as distinct from human resources.
Note 1, the other side: human resources read as internal operations.
Note 2: a large clustering point, so its synonyms and definition say what it covers.
Note 3: clusters with public health and with water, so related links to both; broader unchanged.
Note 4: spell out what DD means; "DD waiver" kept as a synonym.
Note 4, so that "DD waiver" names the waiver alone: on both concepts it would be ambiguous and the build would remove it from both.

program_areas.description: The broad areas of government work an oversight office reviews: top-level clusters, and the program areas within them. An office adds its own with kl_vocab_import().

concepts.scopeNote: Services delivered to residents: income support, child welfare, disability services, aging, homelessness and similar programs. Not human resources: a government's own staffing and personnel work is under Personnel & HR (concept:personnel-hr), in the cross-cutting cluster.
Improper or excess benefit payments and their recovery across assistance programs. This is the program area; the finding type is ft:improper-payments.

DD stands for developmental disabilities. A Medicaid home and community-based services (HCBS) waiver that pays for services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities in their homes and communities rather than in an institution.

concepts.prefLabel: Economic Development Incentives and Tax Abatements
concepts.scopeNote: Foregone-revenue tools used to induce development (tax abatements, exemptions, tax increment financing, payment-in-lieu-of-taxes agreements) and monitoring of whether recipients meet their commitments. Match the acronym TIF whole-word and case-sensitive.
Licensing and certification of teachers and other education personnel.
911 call intake and emergency dispatch operations: staffing, answer and dispatch times, and call-processing accuracy.
Verification that enrolled students are eligible to attend, and that the enrollment and attendance counts that drive school funding are accurate.
Acquisition, assignment, fuel-card control, maintenance and disposal of government vehicles.

mappings.label: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems

concepts.scopeNote: Labor-market programs: job training and workforce services, unemployment insurance, and related wage and benefit administration. Distinct from Personnel & HR, which covers government as an employer.
Operation and regulation of a government lottery, charitable games and sports wagering.
Issuing construction and occupancy permits, and the inspection and code-enforcement work that follows. Business licensing is a separate area.
A government's own workforce: hiring, classification, pay, discipline and personnel records. Internal operations, not the human services delivered to residents (cluster:human-services).
Determination and verification of applicant eligibility for public assistance benefits (SNAP, TANF and similar), across programs.

Population-level health programs: disease prevention and surveillance, health promotion, environmental health and the health department's regulatory work. Individual treatment programs, such as mental health or substance use, have their own areas.
Management and maintenance of government-owned real property and facilities.

concepts.prefLabel: Small and Minority Business Enterprise Programs

concepts.scopeNote: Federally funded school meal programs (National School Lunch and School Breakfast), including meal-count claiming, eligibility and reimbursement.
